x_ramza_comment: ECL v2.0 RAMZA TRANCE specification envelope.
objective: Propose the durable Jin Notification Center and recoverable Google self-RSVP saga for invitations and task reminders.

input_handles: ATLAS Track A RSVP safety findings
ATLAS Track B storage and scheduler findings
context_delta.summary: Full-tier TRANCE specification with eight serialized implementation stories and 67 frozen EARS checks. It defines a versioned device-local Notification Center, durable task-reminder ingestion, canonical invitation reconciliation, a pending-overlay RSVP saga joined by operation ID, exact immutable route and generation guards, one bounded 412 retry, precise recurrence identities, accessible desktop/mobile UI, and deferred native actions and proposed-time support.

assumptions: The provider propagates attendee responseStatus to the organizer copy when sendUpdates=none; a disposable provider smoke is a release gate.
The existing recoverable operation and outbox boundary can add a dedicated RSVP operation without optimistic canonical response mutation.
Native notification submission remains a best-effort title/body signal and never the durable source of truth.
